task_name: Key/status allocation and final status NOT NULL

concerns_addressed: Cycle-2 agent coverage is resolved: the real agent-board integration now requires five cards, exact sequential key numbers and formatted keys, joins every card to its allocated status, asserts the expected backlog/todo/in_progress geometry, and retains the zero card_events assertion (server/src/routes/cards-identity.integration.test.ts:242-319).

Cycle-2 seed coverage is resolved: the integration test executes seedDemoCards against a real workspace and verifies every demo row, unique key numbers 1-6, non-null status ids, and expected slots (server/src/routes/cards-identity.integration.test.ts:321-361).

Cycle-2 final-nullability coverage is resolved: both fresh and existing migration fixtures stage NULL status rows before the slot/backfill phase, execute the final guarded SET NOT NULL migration, and unconditionally assert a subsequent NULL insert fails with SQLSTATE 23502 (server/src/db/board-tracker-unify-migration.integration.test.ts:217-282, 304-317).

Cycle-1 migration fixture repair remains intact: live/deleted rows, prefilled values, timestamps, tracker keys, null-only backfill, and idempotent rerun/counter preservation remain asserted (server/src/db/board-tracker-unify-migration.integration.test.ts:284-383).

The complete T4 contract is present: transactional counter allocation and null-safe sibling mapping, human and agent identity writes, statusId rejection, soft-delete key retention, ordered idempotent final nullability, and no agent-schema/service/pipeline changes in the worktree diff.

strengths: The shared allocator performs an atomic workspace counter UPDATE ... RETURNING and is called inside the human, agent, and seed transaction boundaries without activity or event side effects.
Agent integration assertions now inspect actual persisted key_number/status_id/status slot values and verify the five real board columns' position geometry rather than only checking card count.
Seed integration assertions execute the seed helper against PostgreSQL and validate every persisted demo row, not just seed source text.
Migration integration genuinely verifies NULL legacy rows before the final constraint and SQLSTATE 23502 rejection afterward, while preserving backfill, deleted-row, timestamp, and rerun assertions.
The static migration test checks additive DDL, slot seed, status/key backfill, and final SET NOT NULL order; the diff has no prohibited agent-schema, service, or pipeline edits.

issues.description: The newly added card identity integration suite is 374 lines and remains a monolithic file over the approximately 300-line refactor threshold. Its agent scenario is also a long test callback (approximately 78 lines) combining asynchronous pipeline polling, database retrieval, geometry assertions, identity assertions, and activity assertions. Split the suite or extract focused setup/query/assertion helpers so the changed test structure stays below the threshold and the long callback has a single responsibility.

The new seedDemoCards function is approximately 67 lines and combines demo-card declaration, transactional allocation/insertion, timestamp policy, and event insertion in one function, exceeding the approximately 50-line function threshold. Extract the card definitions and/or per-card transactional insertion into focused helpers while preserving the single transaction boundary.

fix_instructions: ESCALATE: The T4 round budget is exhausted (cycle 3, cycles_remaining 0). Before any later audit, split server/src/routes/cards-identity.integration.test.ts so the newly added suite is not a monolithic >300-line file and extract the long agent test callback, and split seedDemoCards in server/src/db/seed.ts so no function exceeds the approximately 50-line heuristic. Preserve all real agent, seed, migration, counter, status, activity, rerun, deleted-row, timestamp, and SQLSTATE 23502 assertions. Re-run the three exact T4 gate commands, then perform a new read-only audit; do not merge this blocked worktree.
